hero.title: Home Assistant AI Digest
hero.copy: Turn Home Assistant warnings, unavailable entities, stale sensors, and delivery failures into a private daily briefing you can act on.
hero.privacy: Secrets are sent only to the local backend and displayed as masks after validation.

onboarding.title: Guided onboarding

fields.privacyAccepted: I accept that selected data may be sent to the AI provider to generate reports.

onboarding.schedulePrivacyNotice: We will save this schedule and privacy level before running the first digest. Secrets stay referenced and masked.
onboarding.firstDigestNotice: The setup is ready. Validation will save the settings and queue the first digest.

explanations.homeAssistant: We need Home Assistant access to detect incidents. The URL and token are validated before continuing.
explanations.aiProvider: AI is required to explain incidents. Choose a provider and add its key; it is never shown in full.
explanations.notifier: Notifications are optional. You can use on-screen reports and configure Telegram later.
explanations.schedule: The schedule controls when reports are generated.
explanations.privacy: Privacy controls what context may be sent to AI and how long it is retained.
explanations.schedulePrivacy: The schedule controls when reports are generated. Privacy controls what context may be sent to AI and how long it is retained.

progress.success: Settings saved. The first digest is queued.
progress.retry: Setup could not be completed. Review the message and retry.

errors.haUrl: Enter a valid Home Assistant URL.
errors.settingsPersistenceUnavailable: Settings could not be saved before the first digest. Check the secure backend connection and try again.
errors.privacyAccepted: Confirm how data will be used before continuing.

error.title: State could not be updated
error.copy: The state will appear when the connection recovers.

unavailable.title: State waiting for connection
unavailable.copy: Sign in to view the current state.

empty.title: No pending incidents
empty.copy: Run a report from Active report to check the system.

latestReport.title: Latest report
latestReport.loading: Looking for the latest saved report…

empty.copy: There are no saved reports yet.

error.copy: The latest report could not be determined.

manualDigest.title: Manual digest
manualDigest.copy: Run an on-demand digest against the local backend using saved settings.
manualDigest.unavailableCopy: Manual digests will be available after settings and history are persisted.
manualDigest.error: The manual digest could not be started.

loading.title: Loading history
loading.copy: Looking for saved digests in the local backend.

empty.title: No digests yet
empty.copy: After you run the first digest, it will appear here with its analyzed window and delivery status.

error.title: History could not be loaded
error.copy: Check that the session is still active and try again.

unavailable.title: History waiting for connection
unavailable.copy: History will load after the frontend has a secure backend session.

history.reviewedPeriodHelp: The span of Home Assistant information reviewed to create this report.

aiAnalysis.complete: Every detected problem received an explanation
aiAnalysis.partial: Some detected problems could not be explained
aiAnalysis.failed: AI analysis could not be generated
aiAnalysis.quiet: There were no detected problems to explain
aiAnalysis.unknown: Open the detail to review the available analysis

jobLifecycle.loadError: The report status could not be updated. Try again after the connection has recovered.
jobLifecycle.retryError: The report could not be retried. Check the configuration and try again.

message.queued: The report is waiting for the local worker.
message.collecting: The required data is being collected.
message.generating: The summary is being prepared with saved configuration.
message.saving: The report is being saved to history.
message.completed: The report is now available in history.
message.failed: The report needs a recovery action.

account.bootstrapErrorTitle: Secure access could not be checked
account.bootstrapErrorCopy: The session could not be validated. Check the backend connection and try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.signIn: Sign in to review and update configuration.
settings.loadError: Settings could not be loaded. Check the session and try again.
settings.review: Review the highlighted fields before saving.
settings.saveError: Settings could not be saved. Check the fields and try again.
settings.noteError: The note could not be saved. Review the text and try again.
settings.ignoreError: The ignored warning could not be saved. Review the value and try again.
settings.ignoreRemoveError: The ignored warning could not be removed. It is still available; try again.
settings.telegramError: Telegram test could not be sent. Review the configuration and try again.
settings.heading: Connections, schedule, and privacy
settings.secretDescription: Current secrets are masked. You can keep them or explicitly replace them.
settings.contextDescription: Keep operational context with configuration to avoid duplicate panel changes.
settings.notesUnavailable: Notes are unavailable in this session.
settings.ignoresUnavailable: Ignored warnings are unavailable in this session.
settings.removeIgnoredDescription: The warning “{match}” will appear again in upcoming reports.
settings.loadNotesError: Notes could not be loaded. Try again.
settings.loadIgnoresError: Ignored warnings could not be loaded. Try again.
settings.validHomeAssistantUrl: Enter a valid Home Assistant URL.

report.title: Report details
report.windowHelp: The span of Home Assistant information reviewed to create this report.
report.errorCopy: The report may no longer be available. Return to Reports to review the updated history.
report.emptyContent: This report has no readable content.

attention.title: Attention
attention.copy: This report contains {count} issues that require attention. Review the report content for details.

recommendations.title: Recommendations
recommendations.legacyCopy: No structured recommendations are available for this legacy report.

outcomes.title: Outcomes
outcomes.analysisComplete: {analyzed} of {total} detected problems explained by AI
outcomes.analysisPartial: {analyzed} of {total} detected problems explained by AI. {missing} problems could not be explained.
outcomes.analysisLegacy: This older format does not include structured AI analysis.
outcomes.analysisQuiet: There were no detected problems to explain.
outcomes.notificationFailureCopy: The report exists, but the notification could not be sent. The exact reason was not recorded.
outcomes.notificationFailureUnknown: The exact reason was not recorded.
outcomes.notificationFailureAction: Review the Telegram configuration and send a test from Settings.

telegram_bad_request.action: Send a test from Settings. If it also fails, review the report content and try again.

telegram_auth_failed.action: Review the bot token in Settings and send a test.

telegram_forbidden.copy: Telegram refused delivery to the configured destination.
telegram_forbidden.action: Confirm that the bot can write to the selected chat, then send a test.

telegram_not_found.copy: Telegram could not find the configured bot endpoint.
telegram_not_found.action: Review the bot token and destination in Settings.

telegram_conflict.copy: Telegram reported a conflicting bot operation.
telegram_conflict.action: Check that no other service is using this bot for conflicting operations, then try again.

telegram_rate_limited.action: Wait a few minutes and try again.

telegram_service_unavailable.action: Wait for the service to recover and try again.

telegram_rejected.action: Send a test from Settings and review the bot permissions.

telegram_invalid_response.copy: Telegram's response could not be confirmed.
telegram_invalid_response.action: Check the chat before attempting another send to avoid duplicates.

telegram_request_failed.copy: The application could not reach Telegram.
telegram_request_failed.action: Check the network connection and try again.

telegram_configuration_failed.copy: The saved Telegram configuration could not be used.
telegram_configuration_failed.action: Review the bot token and chat in Settings, then send a test.

batch.warningPartial: AI could not explain every detected problem.
batch.warningCorrupt: Some saved report information could not be read safely.
batch.warningGeneric: The report includes additional information that needs review.
batch.integrationAction: Check that Home Assistant is reachable and generate the report again.

integrationReasons.socket_timeout: Home Assistant did not answer the integration check in time.
integrationReasons.auth_required_missing: Home Assistant returned an unexpected authentication sequence.
integrationReasons.auth_failed: Home Assistant rejected the saved access token.
integrationReasons.command_rejected: Home Assistant rejected the integration status request.
integrationReasons.invalid_result: Home Assistant returned an unreadable integration status response.
integrationReasons.connection_failed: The application could not connect to Home Assistant for the integration check.

batch.integrationSummary: Only aggregate health counts are shown. Integration names and identifiers stay private.
batch.integrationNotLoadedHelp: Not loaded can be normal: an integration may be disabled, unused, or waiting for setup. It does not require action by itself.
batch.integrationInProgressHelp: In progress is informational: Home Assistant is currently setting up or unloading these integrations.
batch.integrationRetryingHelp: Home Assistant will retry these integrations automatically. Review them only if retrying continues.
batch.integrationUnknownHelp: Unknown means Home Assistant returned a state this version cannot classify. Generate another report after updating if it persists.
batch.integrationErrorsHelp: Only integrations with errors need action now. Open Home Assistant to review and repair them.
batch.integrationClear: No integration states requiring action were detected.
batch.groupingExplanation: Repeated messages for the same problem are grouped together so the report is easier to read.
batch.failureInvalidAnalysis: AI could not produce a usable explanation for some of the detected problems.
batch.failureGeneric: AI analysis could not be completed for the detected problems.
batch.analysisUnavailable: AI could not explain this problem.

endpoint_resolution.title: Endpoint resolution problem
endpoint_resolution.copy: Home Assistant could not resolve the Plex endpoint in the recorded events.
endpoint_resolution.action: Review DNS and connectivity if the problem repeats or Plex is unavailable in Home Assistant.

delete.title: Delete Report
delete.description: This action cannot be undone. Only this report will be deleted; other reports and settings will be preserved.
delete.error: The report could not be deleted. It is still available; try again.

legacy.title: Imported report (older format)
legacy.copy: This report was produced by a previous version and does not contain structured AI analysis for each detected problem. Only a new report can provide that analysis.
